script_command_edges.note: Ten further cross-region transitions exist as warp/warpsilent/warpteleport script commands rather than map data. None is reachable from an early legal save. Attribution required a script call graph; one candidate pair (the department-store elevators) was rejected as a false positive because a shared .inc file holds two independent script sets.
examples: OlivineCity_PortInside_hns (Johto) <-> VermilionCity_PortInside_hns (Kanto): ITEM_SS_TICKET, which Elm gives only after the Johto Hall of Fame
GoldenrodCity_TrainStation_hns (Johto) <-> SaffronCity_TrainStation_hns (Kanto): checkitem ITEM_PASS, obtained from the Saffron Copycat
MelemeleIsle_hns (Alola) -> Route13_hns (Kanto): no gate; Route13 -> Alola is gated by checkitem ITEM_STRANGE_SOUVENIR, sold in the Kanto MtMoon_Shop_hns

reachability_from_an_early_legal_save.start: the issue #1 progression chain's furthest accepted checkpoint (Azalea Town area, 2 Johto badges, 3 party members)
evidence: Surf is mandatory and needs FLAG_BADGE04_GET: both the New Bark Town east edge (x=29 rows 11-14) and the Route27 west edge (x=0 rows 22-25) are MB_OCEAN_WATER

Waterfall is mandatory and needs FLAG_BADGE08_GET: TohjoFalls_Cavern's west component joins its centre and east rooms only through the MB_WATERFALL column x=29-34 rows 12-17, and Route27's east half is reachable no other way
flood fill over all 560 H&S maps: no Surf = 161 maps and zero cross-region edges; Surf without Waterfall = 169 maps and zero; Surf + Waterfall = 342 maps, which is where W1 and W3 first appear
even after Surf and Waterfall, ReceptionGate's (11,14) trigger requires VAR_ECRUTEAK_CITY_THEATER >= 8, set only by the Tin Tower Ho-Oh or Whirl Islands Lugia quest

Fly is not a shortcut: of every sMapHealLocations entry exactly one is cross-region (MAPSEC_ROCKET_HIDEOUT_HNS -> Pallet Town with HEAL_LOCATION_NONE, hence unusable), and every CANFLY city is gated by its own FLAG_VISITED_* set only by physically entering

regions_without_any_transition.evidence: exhaustive enumeration finds ZERO edges between any Alola map (groups 25-26) and any Johto or Kanto map. Alola links only to Kanto, via MelemeleIsle_hns <-> Route13_hns script commands

debug_transportation.present_in_release: SOURCE VERIFIED: include/config/debug.h sets DEBUG_OVERWORLD_MENU TRUE with held key R and trigger START, the only disabling line (include/constants/global.h) is commented out, src/debug.c has no top-level #if guard, and the Makefile compiles src/**/*.c unconditionally. A preprocessor probe against the real include tree returns identical results with and without -DRELEASE.
